title: ‘R1’ Arrested, Alleged Mastermind of the Murder of Former Mayor Carlos Manzo
author: Anahí Del Ángel
content:
_This article by Anahí Del Ángel originally appeared in the[July 30, 2026
edition of Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/detienen-
a-r1-presunto-autor-intelectual-del-asesinato-del-exalcalde-carlos-manzo/),
one of Mexico's leading investigative magazines._

**Federal security forces arrested Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala, alias R1,
alleged mastermind of the murder of the former mayor of Uruapan, Michoacán,
Carlos Manzo, which took place on November 1, 2025 at the Plaza Morelos,
during the Festival de las Velas.**

The arrest was confirmed by the head of the Secretariat of Security and
Citizen Protection (SSPC), Omar García Harfuch, in a post through his account
on the social network X.

> Ramón Ángel “N”, alias “R1”, señalado como el autor intelectual del cobarde
> homicidio del exalcalde de Uruapan, Carlos Manzo, fue detenido después de
> meses de trabajos de inteligencia e investigación, en una operación de
> [@SSPCMexico](https://x.com/SSPCMexico?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw) y Fuerzas
> Especiales del Ejército Mexicano…
>
> -- Omar H Garcia Harfuch (@OHarfuch) [July 30,
> 2026](https://x.com/OHarfuch/status/2082911180495200333?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

The official detailed that Álvarez Ayala leads Los Rs, one of the most violent
cells linked to the Cártel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG), whose area of
operation is the municipalities of Apatzingán, Uruapan, and Morelia in
Michoacán, as well as a presence in Jalisco.

In addition, that group is allegedly connected to various high-impact crimes,
including extortion, homicides, and drug trafficking, which directly affects
producers, businesspeople, and families in the region.

**García Harfuch reported that 31 people have now been detained for their
probable participation in the murder of Carlos Manzo.** He indicated that this
action is part of the Michoacán Plan for Peace and Justice, ordered by
President Claudia Sheinbaum.

The Secretary attributed the capture to the work of intelligence and
investigation and the information provided by the National Intelligence
Center. He added that the SSPC and Special Forces of the Mexican Army took
part in the operation.
